name: Pettenderly
tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
description: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a watercolor, royal or studio style, and download the generated digital portrait. Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations do not use credits. The Starter Pack is a one-time purchase of 12 non-expiring credits for $4.99. Pro subscriptions provide 40 credits per month. You & your pet and photo cleanup are beta features, and faces, coat markings and fine details may vary. Results are downloadable digital images; physical prints are not included.
